notes.title: Patch Notes - 7/31/2015 Ver 2.2.1 Rev 29
notes.content:
Hi folks!

Well, unless anyone finds any more glaring problems, this may be the final non-content patch for Dungeon Crawlers HD!  I've definitely left a few features on the table, but the good news is this frees me up to start working on upgrading the engine for the next game.

In this patch i fixed the following two things:

1. The options menu now remembers your settings better, so if you set the difficulty to hard, when you come back to the options menu, it will still say 'hard'

2. You can now turn the joystick support on and off from the options menu, SO - if you forgot to turn the joystick on before you loaded the game, you can now turn it on, and turn on support in the options menu and get cracking.  Or vice versa, you turned it on but dont want to use it, whatever.

if you are enjoying the game, don't forget to leave a positive review, thanks!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 7/29/2015 Ver 2.2 Rev 28
notes.content:
Ok folks,

This patch is to specifically address the inventory issues in the previous patch.  The bug that causes you to lose your inventory after restart in level 3-2 is fixed.  This bug is specific to that level, as no auto save was being created before the level started, which caused a restart to load a game that didn't exist and then forces other issues like missing inventory.

The other issue which (I hope) has been addressed is inventory disappearing when transitioning from 4-3 to 5-1.  I believe this happened because of inventory access problems in that level, but i'm not sure, and i haven't been able to replicate the problem since making the fix.

So, finally, for all of you who lost inventory while playing the game, I have introduced a code that will restore your inventory through level 5-1.  From inside the game (while playing a level, not the main menu) type out the code '51i' (no apostrophes).  You will see a message that says "Inventory Restored".  That's it.

The joystick issue will be addressed in the next update.

notes.title: Bug & Patch Report - 6/4/2015
notes.content:
Hello Dungeon Crawlers friends!

I've received a lot of feedback since launch, and am looking forward to addressing the problems and concerns you've posted about.  A patch should be going up tonight (Thursday, 6/4) or by the latest, Friday afternoon.

Here's what's on the dockett:
- Final portal in 3-2 doesn't work (workaround: quit the game through the menu, then load the game again)
- Necromancer in 5-2 isn't attacking
- missing inventory in some level between 3-2 and 5-2 (if anyone has more details on this, please let me know)
- fix the fonts to something more legible
- add ability to use mouse to move the camera around

Let me know if there's anything else and i will update the post
